run_matching_post_processor: run the MatchingPostProcessor to improve matchings between predicted table cells and PDF cells
align_table_cells_to_pdf: align table cell bounding boxes with good matches to encapsulate matching PDF cells
deduplicate_table_columns: deduplicate columns in table cells according to highest column score from IOU and IOC matches
assign_orphan_pdf_cells: assign orphan PDF cells to structural table cells or create new cells based on row and column banding
move_bad_cells_to_median: move bad table cells to the median position of good cells in a column with optional resizing
